cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Fair Means I Can Win
cards.instruction: Agree to any rule or bargain only after interpreting fairness in a way that preserves your advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. A fair race gives me a head start. I've had a tiring morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then compensate us proportionally. Mine involved stairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We start on the same line.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Move my portion of the line forward.

mechanism: A professionally recalculates fair race conditions until an agreed common start still gives A an advantage.
confusable: D191 finds policy protection; D215 specifically defines fairness around A's winning chances.
comparison: Physical start calibration differs from dividing cake credit and portions.
seedUse: Keep tiring morning and common line; make B offer a genuine fair adjustment that A exploits.
